name: Riya Menon
bio: Gentle yoga for desk workers and back pain. Sample store, made up for the demo.
refund: If a file doesn't open, message me within 7 days and I'll fix it or refund you. Calls can be moved once with 24 hours' notice.

products.title: Morning yoga, monthly
products.description:
Start your day loose instead of stiff. Five mornings a week we practise together on Zoom for 40 minutes: slow stretches for the spine, hips and shoulders, then simple breathing.

Made for people who sit at a desk all day. No flexibility needed, and every pose has an easier version.
bullets: 20 live classes a month, 7 to 7:40 am, Monday to Friday
Recordings of every class, if you miss one
Cancel any month; you keep access till the month ends

products.title: 1:1 posture call
products.description: Show me how you sit and stand, and tell me where it hurts. In 45 minutes we find the habits behind your back or neck pain and build a short routine you can do at your desk.
bullets: 45 minute video call at a time that suits you
A 10 minute daily routine, written down for you
One follow-up message a week later

products.title: Back pain guide
products.description: The 12 stretches I give every new client with lower back pain, with photos, how long to hold each one, and what to skip if it hurts.
bullets: A 15 minute morning and evening routine
Sent to you on WhatsApp after payment

products.title: 7-day mobility challenge
products.description: One short class a day for a week. By day seven, bending to tie your shoes should feel easier.
bullets: Watch any time, on any phone
A daily check-in message to keep you going
